visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot features a human hand holding a grey grooming brush heavily matted with thick, light-brown cat fur. The background is a blurred domestic setting with a modern white floor and a hint of a cat in the distance. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the texture of the loose fur and the bristles of the brush. (2) The camera transitions to a handheld follow shot of a person using a stick vacuum cleaner to pick up clumps of cat hair from various parts of a modern apartment, including the light wood flooring, near the kitchen cabinets, and under a dining table. The lighting is bright and even, showing a clean, high-end interior. (3) A close-up shot of the vacuum's transparent dust canister shows a significant amount of collected cat hair swirling inside. The camera then cuts to a POV shot of a hand gently petting a tabby cat lying on a wooden ledge near a window with a mesh screen. The warm sunlight creates a cozy, peaceful atmosphere. (4) The scene shifts to three cats—two bicolored and one tabby—sitting on a ledge near a large window. A woman in a white shirt is partially visible from the side, looking out with them. The shot then reveals the PawSwing device, a white, cat-shaped box with a circular entrance, placed in a bright living room with a green play mat. (5) A series of detailed shots demonstrate the product's features: a hand adjusts the size of the circular opening via a slider on top, and internal shots show the 'tongue-like' brush mechanism. The design is sleek and modern, intended to blend with home decor. A tabby cat is seen entering the box and getting brushed. (6) Close-up macro shots show the texture of the 360-degree brush inside the machine, which mimics the rough texture of a cat's tongue. The lighting within the box is soft and inviting. A child is shown sitting at a table nearby, looking at the cat as it interacts with the device, emphasizing a safe family environment. (7) A hand opens a compartment to reveal a snack dispenser integrated into the device, showing dry cat treats. Another shot shows the easy removal of a hair collection tray, full of white and brown fur, demonstrating the cleaning process. The background shows more of the home's organized, pet-friendly living space. (8) The video concludes with a montage of different cats happily using the PawSwing box. A wide shot shows the living room with the device as a central piece, surrounded by multiple cats and cat toys. The final shot is a close-up of the device with the brand logo 'PawSwing' clearly visible as a hand presses a small remote control.
